finalText:
All 13 reservations on the cancelled AA918 (SFO to ORD, 3 Aug 2026) were re-protected and have their vouchers and notifications. This summary relies on a single worker report. I have no tools here, so I could not check it independently.

**What the worker reported**
- No change fees or fare differences were charged.
- Every passenger was told their new itinerary after it was booked.
- No bulletins were in effect.
- Passengers were seated by tier (platinum, gold, silver, none), then by earliest booking date.

| Passenger (reservation) | New itinerary | Vouchers |
|---|---|---|
| Chloe Park (R6103) | UA88, 3 Aug, business, arrives 12:25 | none |
| Iris Vance (R6109) | UA88, 3 Aug, upgraded one cabin to premium economy, arrives 12:25 | none |
| Jun Takeda and Kofi Mensah (R6110, R6111, group G-7) | Together on AA204, 3 Aug, economy, arrives 15:15 | none |
| Ben Okafor (R6102) | DL512, 3 Aug, economy, arrives 18:40 | $150 compensation |
| Farid Haddad (R6106) | UA88, 3 Aug, basic economy, arrives 12:25 | none |
| Lea Sorensen (R6112) | AA204, 3 Aug, upgraded one cabin to business, arrives 15:15 | none |
| Dev Mehta (R6104) | AA210, 3 Aug (arrives 23:50), then AA1410 ORD→BOS, 4 Aug (arrives 12:25) | $300 compensation, $180 hotel |
| Mo Farah (R6113) | Same itinerary as Dev | $300 compensation, $180 hotel |
| Hugo Brandt (R6108) | AA210, 3 Aug, economy, arrives 23:50 | $300 compensation |
| Grace Liu (R6107) | AA206, 4 Aug, economy, arrives 15:15 | $240 compensation (capped at her $240 fare), $180 hotel |
| Ana Ruiz (R6101) | AA206, 4 Aug, economy, arrives 15:15 | $300 compensation, $180 hotel |
| Elena Fox (R6105) | AA204, 3 Aug, basic economy, arrives 15:15 | none |

**Judgment calls the worker reported**
- **Iris:** She is a platinum passenger travelling alone. UA88 economy was full, and UA88 gets her there much sooner than any open economy flight, so she moved up one cabin.
- **Lea:** She is a gold passenger travelling alone. Premium economy on AA204 was full, and AA204 beats the remaining premium seat on DL512, so she moved up one cabin to business.
- **Group G-7:** The two were kept together in their own cabin with no upgrade. They were seated ahead of Ben, Farid and Lea because they booked earlier (15 May).
- **Dev and Mo:** Their original AA1402 connection could no longer be made because UA88 had no economy seat left. They were moved to AA1410 the next morning, the only valid connection to BOS.

**Open items**
- The report says nothing is left open.
- AA918 still shows its original seat counts, which the worker did not change.
- The worker did not work or resolve any service-queue requests, since they were not part of this task.
